score: log2(total charged time) + log2(peak memory bytes)
computation_model: Classical probabilistic 256-bit word RAM. One selected-round target compression or sponge permutation costs one unit; every other primitive word operation costs one unit. BLAKE3, when defined, must charge all chunk/parent/root compressions. A field-specific model is required before Poseidon activation.
probability_space: Fresh independent algorithmic coins, fixed selected target. A seeded experiment is reproducibility evidence; its deterministic seed expansion does not establish independent ideal random coins for the full attack.
heuristics: Explicitly declared, evidence-linked heuristic premises are adjudicated under paired-lanes-v1. Epistemic judgment of a premise is distinct from algorithmic success probability.
nominal_reference: The organizer nominal exponent is 64 for MD5, 80 for SHA-1, and 128 for selected 256-bit modern targets, as in the mockup. This is a reference security claim, not a qualified baseline or a proof of a particular time-memory implementation. Constants and bytes remain charged in actual submissions.
nonuniform_advice: A stored precomputed collision is not a cheap construction. All construction/preprocessing and advice must be accounted for, including any search omitted from the submitted program.
quantum: Quantum algorithms are out of scope.
